title: PriceTick
description: One price observation for a real market, from either a historical candle close or a live order-book snapshot. Published on Redis channel 'augury.price.<market_id>'. Book snapshots carry the depth and spread that the LMSR liquidity parameter b is calibrated from (enhancement 4).

source.description: 'candle' is a bar close from history; 'book' is a live top-of-book snapshot. Only 'book' ticks populate the depth fields, so mixing the two without checking this field corrupts any liquidity analysis.

yes_price.description: Probability of YES, as a float in [0,1]. Kalshi reports these as dollar-denominated strings ('0.0300'); parsing to float happens at the client boundary so nothing downstream handles strings.

spread.description: yes_ask - yes_bid. Stored rather than derived so rows with a partial book remain unambiguous.

depth_bid.description: Shares resting on the bid within the quoted range.

depth_ask.description: Shares resting on the ask within the quoted range.
